lead: Khadga Prasad Sharma Oli is a Nepali politician, born on 22 February 1952 in Tehrathum District.
As of 2026, he is 74 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Nepalese Constituent Assembly and Member of the Parliament of Nepal.
Below you will find a verified overview of Khadga Prasad Sharma Oli: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Khadga Prasad Sharma Oli — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Khadga Prasad Sharma Oli was born on 22 February 1952 in Tehrathum District, and holds Nepali nationality.
He is recorded as speaking English, Nepali and Hindi.

sections.heading: Khadga Prasad Sharma Oli — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Nepalese Constituent Assembly, Member of the Parliament of Nepal, Minister of Home Affairs (1994–1995), Deputy Prime Minister of Nepal (2006–2007), Minister of Foreign Affairs (2006–2007) and Prime Minister of Nepal (2015–2016). He is affiliated with Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist).
He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2019.
